item.title: Done Deal: Buffalo Color Park Sold
item.description: The Buffalo Color Park, formerly the Medaille College Sports Complex, has been sold. PVS Chemical Solutions purchased the property from South Buffalo Development LLC yesterday for $13.5 million. The sports complex and chemical facility were misfit neighbors as park users frequently complained about plant odors. The properties purchased encompass 5 Babcock, 427 Elk, 85 Lee and 18 Maurice. item.title: For Lydia Fish: Three Ships to Troy
item.description: “One of one.“ The folklorist and emerita professor Lydia Fish, Ph. D., left us in her sleep on January 20. She was 85–and like that, one of our city’s human treasures is gone. Many of you knew Lydia without knowing it, at least if you’ve spent time around Buffalo in the last fifty years. Generations of servers knew Lydia. item.title: Big Reveal: Neighborhood Health Center on Forest
item.description: Neighborhood Health Center is proposing a new building east of its current Niagara Street Riverway facility. The five-story building would be constructed at the southwest corner of Forest and West avenues on the site of Luigi’s Bakery. Carmina Wood Design’s plan for the building includes 39,720 sq.ft. of space to accommodate expanded healthcare services.
